title: Gift Wrap Roll

adjustment.analysis: Baseline median is 2.7. No events, promotions, or price changes this week. Recent weeks show no sustained trend; the dip after Father's Day (x0.37) and the spike after Independence Day (x1.22) are isolated. Past promotions have noise-adjusted lift of x1.0 and post-promo pullback of x1.0. The classical uplift model's x1.0 is consistent with evidence. No driver justifies a move from baseline. Uncertainty remains high due to product noise (97%) and lack of signal.
